announcements.title: 🎉 Orbit is now on PS4!
announcements.message: Get the downloads and setup instructions from the Orbit Store for PS4 repository: github.com/saawant12/orbit-store-ps4.

announcements.title: You can now support Orbit with crypto
announcements.message: If you’d like to help with development costs, you can now contribute via crypto. It’s entirely optional, and Orbit stays free. Open Support Orbit in Settings to view the options.

announcements.title: Orbit reaches 2,200 games and 5,100 download options!
announcements.message: Plus 628 DLCs and add-ons with 630 options. Refresh the catalogue in Settings to see the latest additions.
